dedupe_keys.name: annual review of safety and radiation protection of french nuclear power plants irsn reports now on the asnr site

description: This page presents the annual review of the safety and radiation protection of France's nuclear power plants, drawing on the technical appraisal of the former IRSN, whose reports on the state of safety and radiation protection of the French reactor fleet have been prepared every year since 2007. The page notes that France has 58 power reactors in operation and about 70 other nuclear installations, including fuel-cycle plants and reactors shut down permanently. The appraisal is based on analysis of information sent by operators, mainly systematic use of incident reports, and studies carried out by the institute; the reports summarise its conclusions with an educational aim and do not claim to be exhaustive. Regular annual publication outside media events is meant to give stakeholders and the public a better sense of the concrete safety issues, progress and shortcomings. Coverage is the French reactor fleet. Access: web page and annual reports on the ASNR site, free; no licence is stated and the individual report years were not opened. It suits nuclear plant performance and resilience studies, and relates to the ASNR nuclear incident notices record catalogued here.
